data.content_ref: inline:Strengthen skepticism across conditioning regimes by computing the grounded extension on a family of school-projected attack subgraphs — each projection a deterministic function of the graph per registered school (1958b39701612057) — and committing only the intersection of all grounded extensions; refutation then commits only for nodes outside the union. Determinism and polynomial cost hold if the school set is fixed and each projection is linear in edge count. The criticizable point: the intersection of several grounded extensions is not itself a Dung grounded extension, so reinstatement must be re-derived and may fail on nodes that are reinstated in every projection yet suspended in the intersection, weakening the very guarantee being extended.
